author: Praxis IV
title: Batch-aware feature weighting × GraphFWPCA @ Ridge (bafw_beta=0.50)
abstract: Introduces batch-aware per-gene weights w_g=(1−R2_batch(g))^β combined multiplicatively with GraphFWPCA variance weights to down-weight batch-predictable genes before PCA. Evaluated at the frozen ridge (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,α_g=0.50,seed=0).
